lines.text: Imagine driving a car that obeys you three seconds late. That is every day on Mars. So who do you trust to drive?

sync.what: the camera starts to fall towards Mars (on "So who")

lines.text: We built that day. One rover, one day of sunlight, rocks to collect, and one rule: be home before the battery dies.

sync.what: the title LIGHTLAG TRAVERSE comes up

lines.text: Then we handed the keys to nine AI models from three labs. Surely one of them makes it home?
Mars doesn't play fair. A fast one reaches for a rock and misses, by 3 centimetres. No points. 9 tries, 1 rock.

sync.what: MISS appears over the rover (on "misses")

lines.text: A bigger one drives onto a slope too steep. The rover freezes and forgets its orders. 30 times.

sync.what: STOPPED appears over the rover (on "freezes")

lines.text: And a flagship: 13 metres from home, 21 samples on board. It will not make it.

sync.what: the battery runs flat and the picture dips (as "It will not make it" ends)
the score-card comes up

lines.text: Nothing broke. So what went wrong?
Its own report says why: the planner counted time, never the battery. And it played all three maps without checking one result.

sync.what: the first quotation comes up
the second quotation comes up (on "And it played")

lines.text: The sun. It's the only fuel. This rover drove until its battery was flat.

sync.what: the rover's battery runs flat (on "flat")

lines.text: Our driver saw its battery fall, stopped, and waited for light. So how did all nine do?

sync.what: the planner's card WAITS FOR THE SUN comes up

lines.text: On three maps in a row, none beat our driver. The best run came within a hair. Ours brought home 48%, and never lost a rover. So what is it?

sync.what: a ring marks the best single run (on "The best run")
the planner's label lights up (on "Ours")

lines.text: Not an AI. A planner: plain code that works out the whole day before the wheels turn. Lucky maps?

sync.what: the first link lights (on "Not an AI")
the second link lights (on "A planner")
the third link lights (on "plain code")
the last link lights (on "before the wheels")

lines.text: So we replayed every model's best program on 300 fresh worlds, on Modal. The planner won 95 times in 100. Can a machine learn it instead?

sync.what: the totals come up (on "The planner won")
the small note comes up (on "Can a machine")

lines.text: We trained a small one from scratch: from 8% to 36% on unseen worlds, still short of the planner. Even a model trained to pick the planner's strategy gained less than half a point.

sync.what: the campaign row comes up (on "still short")
the panel about the planner itself comes up (on "Even a model")

lines.text: AI can write the code. It can't yet plan the day. Can your agent make it home?

sync.what: the live-demo line comes up (on "It can't yet")
the question comes up (on "Can your agent")
